prompt: Style these points by facility type, showing only park, water, and building categories
criteria: config.categories must be an array of strings (NOT a shortcut object like {"type": "top"})
categories array must include exactly: ["park", "water", "building"] in any order
paint.color must be a categorical palette shortcut like '@catPalette4' (NOT an explicit color array)
Must use default size: 4 for points
Must use default opacity: 0.9 for points
Must include showOther: true (to show data values not in explicit list as 'Other')
legend.displayName must be an object with category keys mapped to human-readable names
